title: rosa × centifolia var. cristata
intro: Rosa × centifolia var. cristata, commonly known as the dwarf English rose, is a compact and fragrant variety of the Rosa × centifolia rose species, characterized by its small, delicate flowers and short stems. The plant is known for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and stress. Rosa × centifolia var. cristata is also valued for its therapeutic actions, such as its ability to stimulate the immune system, promote wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
